name: SaaS Standard (TypeScript)
why: One language front and back, shared types across the API boundary, and the largest ecosystem of reference material — AI builders make fewer wrong guesses on this path.
tradeoffs: Node toolchain weight; vendor gravity toward Vercel defaults.
avoid_when: The core is data/ML-heavy (pair with a Python service or use the Python standard).

build_order.title: Scaffold the app
build_order.description: Next.js project boots with the base layout and a health check.

build_order.title: Model the data
build_order.description: Postgres schema and ORM models for the core entities.

build_order.title: Add accounts
build_order.description: Sign-up and sign-in with Auth.js guarding the app pages.

build_order.title: Build the core features
build_order.description: The must-have features working end to end against real data.

build_order.title: Wire payments
build_order.description: Stripe checkout and webhooks for the paid tier, when the product charges.

build_order.title: Polish and harden
build_order.description: Error states, notifications and admin touches, and green end-to-end tests.

testing_defaults.tiers: test-first business logic and API routes; smoke/integration for UI

philosophy_fit: Moderate: free tiers exist end-to-end but the toolchain is not lightweight.
